units.rawText:
This path leads to a high lookout point.
If you follow the stairs leading down from the point, you can leave the garden or return to where 416 is.
units.displayText:
This path leads to a high lookout point.
If you follow the stairs leading down from the point, you can leave the garden or return to where 416 is.

spans.text:
This path leads to a high lookout point.
If you follow the stairs leading down from the point, you can leave the garden or return to where 416 is.

units.rawText: We'll have to move quickly and quietly. If 416 catches wind of us, we'll be in trouble.
units.displayText: We'll have to move quickly and quietly. If 416 catches wind of us, we'll be in trouble.

spans.text: We'll have to move quickly and quietly. If 416 catches wind of us, we'll be in trouble.

units.rawText: I'll do what I can. If we really run into her, I'll have to depend on you.
units.displayText: I'll do what I can. If we really run into her, I'll have to depend on you.

spans.text: I'll do what I can. If we really run into her, I'll have to depend on you.

units.rawText: Of course. Isn't that how it's always been?
units.displayText: Of course. Isn't that how it's always been?

spans.text: Of course. Isn't that how it's always been?

units.rawText: Haha, harsh. We'll descend from here?
units.displayText: Haha, harsh. We'll descend from here?

spans.text: Haha, harsh. We'll descend from here?

units.rawText: No, there's another way.
units.displayText: No, there's another way.

spans.text: No, there's another way.

units.rawText: Isn't this the only path here?
units.displayText: Isn't this the only path here?

spans.text: Isn't this the only path here?

units.rawText: There's another one towards the back, blocked from this angle. I saw it when I was up here last time.
units.displayText: There's another one towards the back, blocked from this angle. I saw it when I was up here last time.

spans.text: There's another one towards the back, blocked from this angle. I saw it when I was up here last time.

units.rawText: We'll see it when we get over there.
units.displayText: We'll see it when we get over there.

spans.text: We'll see it when we get over there.

units.rawText: Alright, we'll do as you say.
units.displayText: Alright, we'll do as you say.

spans.text: Alright, we'll do as you say.

units.rawText: I take a few steps in the direction she indicates, but the only thing in my field of view are the railings of the lookout.
units.displayText: I take a few steps in the direction she indicates, but the only thing in my field of view are the railings of the lookout.

spans.text: I take a few steps in the direction she indicates, but the only thing in my field of view are the railings of the lookout.

units.rawText: Feeling a sense of foreboding, I look back in Clukay's direction.
units.displayText: Feeling a sense of foreboding, I look back in Clukay's direction.

spans.text: Feeling a sense of foreboding, I look back in Clukay's direction.

units.rawText: She was not following me, but rather she was standing still, raising her weapon and aiming at—
units.displayText: She was not following me, but rather she was standing still, raising her weapon and aiming at—

spans.text: She was not following me, but rather she was standing still, raising her weapon and aiming at—

units.rawText: The stairs going down.
units.displayText: The stairs going down.

spans.text: The stairs going down.

units.rawText: ...Clukay!!
units.displayText: ...Clukay!!

spans.text: ...Clukay!!

units.rawText: She looks towards me and shows me her seldom-present smile, swiftly leaping off the lookout—only a voice from the communications channel remains.
units.displayText: She looks towards me and shows me her seldom-present smile, swiftly leaping off the lookout—only a voice from the communications channel remains.

spans.text: She looks towards me and shows me her seldom-present smile, swiftly leaping off the lookout—only a voice from the communications channel remains.

units.rawText: The longer we stay together, the more I can understand what "she" is thinking.
units.displayText: The longer we stay together, the more I can understand what "she" is thinking.

spans.text: The longer we stay together, the more I can understand what "she" is thinking.

units.rawText: When I become the very definition of dangerous, the last thing I want is to drag you into my business. It's best if you never see me like that at all, really.
units.displayText: When I become the very definition of dangerous, the last thing I want is to drag you into my business. It's best if you never see me like that at all, really.

spans.text: When I become the very definition of dangerous, the last thing I want is to drag you into my business. It's best if you never see me like that at all, really.

units.rawText: The sound of 416's laughing grows louder. I almost leap towards the balcony, but the fierce sound of gunfire rings out below.
units.displayText: The sound of 416's laughing grows louder. I almost leap towards the balcony, but the fierce sound of gunfire rings out below.

spans.text: The sound of 416's laughing grows louder. I almost leap towards the balcony, but the fierce sound of gunfire rings out below.

units.rawText: As vicious as last time...
units.displayText: As vicious as last time...

spans.text: As vicious as last time...

units.rawText: After a heated exchange, Clukay takes advantage of an opportunity to take cover and reload her weapon with practiced motions.
units.displayText: After a heated exchange, Clukay takes advantage of an opportunity to take cover and reload her weapon with practiced motions.

spans.text: After a heated exchange, Clukay takes advantage of an opportunity to take cover and reload her weapon with practiced motions.

units.rawText: The same sound of a magazine dropping to the floor comes from behind, the rhythm and cadence one and the same.
units.displayText: The same sound of a magazine dropping to the floor comes from behind, the rhythm and cadence one and the same.

spans.text: The same sound of a magazine dropping to the floor comes from behind, the rhythm and cadence one and the same.

units.rawText: ...Annoying.
units.displayText: ...Annoying.

spans.text: ...Annoying.

units.rawText: Hey, let's have a proper fight if you're done reloading! Stop hiding and just taking potshots!
units.displayText: Hey, let's have a proper fight if you're done reloading! Stop hiding and just taking potshots!

spans.text: Hey, let's have a proper fight if you're done reloading! Stop hiding and just taking potshots!

units.rawText: You... have no right... to speak of proper!
units.displayText: You... have no right... to speak of proper!

spans.text: You... have no right... to speak of proper!

units.rawText: Hah?
units.displayText: Hah?

spans.text: Hah?

units.rawText: Clukay wanted to retort with a snarky remark, but the sound of something piercing through the air reaches her ears first.
units.displayText: Clukay wanted to retort with a snarky remark, but the sound of something piercing through the air reaches her ears first.

spans.text: Clukay wanted to retort with a snarky remark, but the sound of something piercing through the air reaches her ears first.

units.rawText: Crap! Grenade—
units.displayText: Crap! Grenade—

spans.text: Crap! Grenade—

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: That was close...
units.displayText: That was close...

spans.text: That was close...

units.rawText: The rat's been forced out of hiding... And in my range...
units.displayText: The rat's been forced out of hiding... And in my range...

spans.text: The rat's been forced out of hiding... And in my range...

units.rawText: Hah—my range too!
units.displayText: Hah—my range too!

spans.text: Hah—my range too!

units.rawText: Within the smoke, 416's dark purplish figure grows blurrier.
units.displayText: Within the smoke, 416's dark purplish figure grows blurrier.

spans.text: Within the smoke, 416's dark purplish figure grows blurrier.

units.rawText: Commander... Professor, has always been with you...
units.displayText: Commander... Professor, has always been with you...

spans.text: Commander... Professor, has always been with you...

units.rawText: You say that like you've seen it with your own eyes... Huh? This is...
units.displayText: You say that like you've seen it with your own eyes... Huh? This is...

spans.text: You say that like you've seen it with your own eyes... Huh? This is...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Sorry for the wait, Commander. Can you still move?</color>
units.displayText: Sorry for the wait, Commander. Can you still move?

spans.text: Sorry for the wait, Commander. Can you still move?

units.rawText: This voice in my head... memory fragments?
units.displayText: This voice in my head... memory fragments?

spans.text: This voice in my head... memory fragments?

units.rawText: <color=orange>Let me go. You won't find anyone more suitable.</color>
units.displayText: Let me go. You won't find anyone more suitable.

spans.text: Let me go. You won't find anyone more suitable.

units.rawText: I can't put together anything in the way of tactics like this... ugh!
units.displayText: I can't put together anything in the way of tactics like this... ugh!

spans.text: I can't put together anything in the way of tactics like this... ugh!

units.rawText: At a time like this... You dare get distracted, in a battle for the Commander?
units.displayText: At a time like this... You dare get distracted, in a battle for the Commander?

spans.text: At a time like this... You dare get distracted, in a battle for the Commander?

units.rawText: If only your memory fragments weren't here to get in my way...
units.displayText: If only your memory fragments weren't here to get in my way...

spans.text: If only your memory fragments weren't here to get in my way...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Crap, if this continues, your data... Focus! Get over here!</color>
units.displayText: Crap, if this continues, your data... Focus! Get over here!

spans.text: Crap, if this continues, your data... Focus! Get over here!

units.rawText: <color=orange>Commander... Grab onto my hand...</color>
units.displayText: Commander... Grab onto my hand...

spans.text: Commander... Grab onto my hand...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Look at me...</color>
units.displayText: Look at me...

spans.text: Look at me...

units.rawText: Snap out of it, Clukay!
units.displayText: Snap out of it, Clukay!

spans.text: Snap out of it, Clukay!

units.rawText: <size=36>Ah!</size>
units.displayText: Ah!

spans.text: Ah!

units.rawText: Springing to her feet, Clukay twists sideways to dodge 416's shots.
units.displayText: Springing to her feet, Clukay twists sideways to dodge 416's shots.

spans.text: Springing to her feet, Clukay twists sideways to dodge 416's shots.

units.rawText: Too close...
units.displayText: Too close...

spans.text: Too close...

units.rawText: I'm using the encrypted channel. What's happening, Clukay?
units.displayText: I'm using the encrypted channel. What's happening, Clukay?

spans.text: I'm using the encrypted channel. What's happening, Clukay?

units.rawText: This thing... when I get close to her, my neural cloud resonates with hers, and I see leftover memory fragments.
units.displayText: This thing... when I get close to her, my neural cloud resonates with hers, and I see leftover memory fragments.

spans.text: This thing... when I get close to her, my neural cloud resonates with hers, and I see leftover memory fragments.

units.rawText: Simply put, I can't concentrate properly...
units.displayText: Simply put, I can't concentrate properly...

spans.text: Simply put, I can't concentrate properly...

units.rawText: —An opening!
units.displayText: —An opening!

spans.text: —An opening!

units.rawText:
While Clukay was being interrupted by the fragmented memory data, the Entropized 416's offensive only grows more intense.
Every stutter and startle from Clukay becomes a window of opportunity for 416.
units.displayText:
While Clukay was being interrupted by the fragmented memory data, the Entropized 416's offensive only grows more intense.
Every stutter and startle from Clukay becomes a window of opportunity for 416.

spans.text:
While Clukay was being interrupted by the fragmented memory data, the Entropized 416's offensive only grows more intense.
Every stutter and startle from Clukay becomes a window of opportunity for 416.

units.rawText: Clukay!
units.displayText: Clukay!

spans.text: Clukay!

units.rawText: Don't worry... I have an idea...
units.displayText: Don't worry... I have an idea...

spans.text: Don't worry... I have an idea...

units.rawText: Still muttering to yourself?
units.displayText: Still muttering to yourself?

spans.text: Still muttering to yourself?

units.rawText: The more intense one's emotions, the more extreme their actions. I'm waiting for her to show an opening...
units.displayText: The more intense one's emotions, the more extreme their actions. I'm waiting for her to show an opening...

spans.text: The more intense one's emotions, the more extreme their actions. I'm waiting for her to show an opening...

units.rawText: You see me, and I see you... Give me the Commander back!
units.displayText: You see me, and I see you... Give me the Commander back!

spans.text: You see me, and I see you... Give me the Commander back!

units.rawText: 416 advances onwards, the outpouring of firepower giving Clukay barely any time to even breathe.
units.displayText: 416 advances onwards, the outpouring of firepower giving Clukay barely any time to even breathe.

spans.text: 416 advances onwards, the outpouring of firepower giving Clukay barely any time to even breathe.

units.rawText: I was enough from the very beginning... I alone am enough! The Commander only belongs to me!
units.displayText: I was enough from the very beginning... I alone am enough! The Commander only belongs to me!

spans.text: I was enough from the very beginning... I alone am enough! The Commander only belongs to me!

units.rawText: Now!
units.displayText: Now!

spans.text: Now!

units.rawText: In a tense fight like this... What kind of shameful things are you saying—!
units.displayText: In a tense fight like this... What kind of shameful things are you saying—!

spans.text: In a tense fight like this... What kind of shameful things are you saying—!

units.rawText: One more gunshot rings out, the bullet grazing Clukay's right shoulder. She made no attempt to dodge whatsoever, meeting 416 face-to-face, fist swinging—
units.displayText: One more gunshot rings out, the bullet grazing Clukay's right shoulder. She made no attempt to dodge whatsoever, meeting 416 face-to-face, fist swinging—

spans.text: One more gunshot rings out, the bullet grazing Clukay's right shoulder. She made no attempt to dodge whatsoever, meeting 416 face-to-face, fist swinging—

units.rawText: Too slow!
units.displayText: Too slow!

spans.text: Too slow!

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: 416 dodges as if she already knew it was coming, and afterwards—
units.displayText: 416 dodges as if she already knew it was coming, and afterwards—

spans.text: 416 dodges as if she already knew it was coming, and afterwards—

units.rawText: BANG!
units.displayText: BANG!

spans.text: BANG!

units.rawText: Clukay!
units.displayText: Clukay!

spans.text: Clukay!

units.rawText: Clukay's left arm fell to her side, powerless, operands bleeding from the elbow joint like sparks.
units.displayText: Clukay's left arm fell to her side, powerless, operands bleeding from the elbow joint like sparks.

spans.text: Clukay's left arm fell to her side, powerless, operands bleeding from the elbow joint like sparks.

units.rawText: You know my habits... and I naturally know yours...
units.displayText: You know my habits... and I naturally know yours...

spans.text: You know my habits... and I naturally know yours...

units.rawText: You're nothing more than a defective product. You don't have those memories... what right do you have to stand beside the Commander?
units.displayText: You're nothing more than a defective product. You don't have those memories... what right do you have to stand beside the Commander?

spans.text: You're nothing more than a defective product. You don't have those memories... what right do you have to stand beside the Commander?

units.rawText: Those memories... Didn't you make them with the Professor? What are you being so smug about...
units.displayText: Those memories... Didn't you make them with the Professor? What are you being so smug about...

spans.text: Those memories... Didn't you make them with the Professor? What are you being so smug about...

units.rawText: Though injured, Clukay eagerly meets her opponent in the war of words.
units.displayText: Though injured, Clukay eagerly meets her opponent in the war of words.

spans.text: Though injured, Clukay eagerly meets her opponent in the war of words.

units.rawText: How could you understand that? You haven't experienced anything!
units.displayText: How could you understand that? You haven't experienced anything!

spans.text: How could you understand that? You haven't experienced anything!

units.rawText: So what if I can't remember! I can continue making these experiences... and the Professor is inclined to agree!
units.displayText: So what if I can't remember! I can continue making these experiences... and the Professor is inclined to agree!

spans.text: So what if I can't remember! I can continue making these experiences... and the Professor is inclined to agree!

units.rawText: ...Despicable! ...The Commander, Professor, power... give it back to me!
units.displayText: ...Despicable! ...The Commander, Professor, power... give it back to me!

spans.text: ...Despicable! ...The Commander, Professor, power... give it back to me!

units.rawText: The Entropy-corrupted neural segment grows more and more aggressive, its maddened attacks pouring down on the injured Clukay—
units.displayText: The Entropy-corrupted neural segment grows more and more aggressive, its maddened attacks pouring down on the injured Clukay—

spans.text: The Entropy-corrupted neural segment grows more and more aggressive, its maddened attacks pouring down on the injured Clukay—

units.rawText: No, my thoughts... not like this...
units.displayText: No, my thoughts... not like this...

spans.text: No, my thoughts... not like this...

units.rawText: We're the same person... Idiot...
units.displayText: We're the same person... Idiot...

spans.text: We're the same person... Idiot...

units.rawText: Even if I don't remember anything, I've put the Professor in the safest place just like you... even if it's further away from me!
units.displayText: Even if I don't remember anything, I've put the Professor in the safest place just like you... even if it's further away from me!

spans.text: Even if I don't remember anything, I've put the Professor in the safest place just like you... even if it's further away from me!

units.rawText: <size=40>Give it back!</size>
units.displayText: Give it back!

spans.text: Give it back!

units.rawText: Pro... fessor...
units.displayText: Pro... fessor...

spans.text: Pro... fessor...

units.rawText: —I have to do something.
units.displayText: —I have to do something.

spans.text: —I have to do something.

units.rawText: Clukay!
units.displayText: Clukay!

spans.text: Clukay!

units.rawText: The two stop in unison, looking up at me on the balcony above as if they were in a trance.
units.displayText: The two stop in unison, looking up at me on the balcony above as if they were in a trance.

spans.text: The two stop in unison, looking up at me on the balcony above as if they were in a trance.

units.rawText: <size=36>Let me help you, Clukay!</size>
units.displayText: Let me help you, Clukay!

spans.text: Let me help you, Clukay!
